commands: claude mcp add --transport http seiche https://api.seiche.info/mcp

notes: Anonymous access exposes 11 public read-only tools; optional bearer credentials unlock five subscriber-only tools.

On 2026-08-21, a live MCP initialize returned server version 0.10.0, tools/list returned these 11 public tools with readOnlyHint=true on every tool, and world_markets_context(section=summary) returned ok=true.

On 2026-08-22, a fresh live MCP initialize returned server version 0.10.1; tools/list again returned exactly 11 public tools with readOnlyHint=true on every tool; world_markets_context(section=summary) returned ok=true with schema seiche.world-markets.v1; and the official MCP Registry returned io.github.beepboop2025/seiche 0.10.1 with status=active and isLatest=true.
